results.title: Crystal Lake Girls
results.overview: When young, hot, nubile Madison agrees to spend the summer at the “Crystal Lake Retreat”, a new cozy institution for troubled young women instead of prison, she thinks her troubles are over. Girl fights and lecherous guards? No problem. However, for poor Madison, that is when the real trouble begins as this summer marks the 30th Anniversary of Jason’s murderous killing spree on Friday the 13th. Now Madison is locked in with seven other women as they are hunted by a serial killer known only as “the President”, several guards who are pigs, one head honcho who is a hottie and a couple of yahoos for the law.  Can she survive or will she become another victim?

results.title: Partnership
results.overview: In a near-future social media economy, a lonely streamer lands a job as the on-screen boyfriend of a famous influencer. As he navigates rehearsed romance and professional intimacy, the line between genuine connection and performance begins to blur.

results.title: Dunganda Street Sounds
results.overview: An energised showcase of Yolngu culture, language + community, Dunganda Street Sounds brought together musicians living on + around Dunganda Crescent in Ramingining. With visual direction shaped by Jason Durrurranga + Michael Dawu, this proto-YouTube music video anthology sees boss men from Waak Waak Djungi guiding the next generations. Widely known across north-east Arnhem Land via its independent CD release, its film counterpart has rarely been seen in the years since + is shared here from project coordinator Allen Murphy’s digital archive.

results.title: Dream of Birds
results.overview: What happens when a forest loses its birdsong? Following clues hidden in the sounds birds make while asleep, Argentinian physicist Gabriel Mindlin uncovers a hidden extinction – not of species, but of memory – and sets out to revive vanished melodies before they disappear forever. Part detective story, part cutting-edge science, Mindlin's mission leads him to the dusty 1960s archives of Buenos Aires naturalist, confirming that some songs no longer echo in the biosphere. So he deploys "robot tutors" to see whether young birds can learn and spread the old songs once again.

results.title: The Stage
results.overview: A personal assistant for her stage director father, Carrie Russell yearns for the stage. Her father unfortunately is unimpressed. With auditions being held for her father's final production and a rising star going for the role, Carrie takes her shot.

results.title: From Young to Old: Historical Film Footage from the Zaan Region
results.original_title: Van Jong tot Oud: Historische filmbeelden uit de Zaanstreek
results.overview: How were health, sport, leisure, care and everyday life viewed in the past? As part of the Month of History, the Zaanstad Municipal Archives presents a special film evening featuring an exclusive compilation of historical footage from its own film collection. The compilation shows how residents of the Zaan region worked, exercised, relaxed, lived and cared for one another over the years. The screening offers a unique glimpse into the past of the Zaan region.

results.title: Djävulens krig
results.overview: On snow-covered fields in the small village of Napue in Ostrobothnia, a terribly one-sided battle is being fought in the bitter February cold. The Swedish army numbers 4,500 men. The Russian force consists of over 10,000 soldiers. The odds are impossible to overcome, and the Swedish defeat is total. The year is 1714, and the entire eastern half of the kingdom is now under Russian control. The era of the Great Northern War has begun.
